description: This file defines a Java class 'ExpandableListItem' used as a data model for list items that can be expanded or collapsed in an Android UI. It stores properties like title, text, image resource, and height measurements, and implements an interface 'OnSizeChangedListener' to update its expanded height.

classes.name: ExpandableListItem
classes.description: A class representing an item in an expandable list with properties for title, text, image resource, and height states, and it tracks whether the item is expanded.

methods.name: isExpanded
methods.description: Returns whether the list item is currently expanded.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Sets the expansion state of the list item.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the list item.

methods.name: getCollapsedHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the item in collapsed state.

methods.name: setCollapsedHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the item in collapsed state.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the extra text associated with the item.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the extra text for the item.

methods.name: getExpandedHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the item in expanded state.

methods.name: setExpandedHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the item in expanded state.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Callback method invoked when the size of the item changes; updates the expanded height.
